description: Sven Cinematic Universe — Master Production Presets & Runbooks Catalog. Governs 1-click project initialization, automated parameter locking, model targeting, and audit thresholds for Antigravity IDE. NOTE: Aspect ratio is ALWAYS 100% user-governed and never rigidly fixed.
aspect_ratio_sovereignty_law: The aspect ratio (16:9 horizontal, 9:16 vertical, 4:3, 1:1, or 2.39:1 anamorphic) is ALWAYS governed by the user's explicit choice. Presets provide default baseline recommendations, but the Director and Screenwriter must seamlessly adapt staging to ANY aspect ratio chosen by the user.
html_deliverable_policy: SINGLE-HTML RESOURCE RULE: Output ONLY output/<slug>/setting.html (Stage 2) to prepare Character/Prop/Location reference images. Strictly ZERO tap-1.html ... tap-N.html files. Stage 1 (Master Storyline), Stage 3 (Episode-by-Episode Rough Script & 7-Point Cross-Check), and Stage 4 (Scene-by-Scene 4-Part Interactive Scene Card & Reference Cross-Check) execute 100% interactively in chat.
continuity_reference_protocol: 3-Case Continuity Reference Point Law: TH1 (Same Time & Location -> Mandatory Last-Frame Static Reference) | TH2 (Different Location/Time/Cast -> No Previous Frame Reference, Use New Location & Character Refs) | TH3 (Supernatural / Time-Travel Spatial Shift -> Keep Character Posture/Momentum/Prop from Last Frame + Replace Context with New Location Ref)
cross_genre_action_chase_routing: Every episode across narrative genres weaves >= 1-2 high-tension kinetic action, chase, pursuit, physical struggle, or combat scenes (10.0s or 15.0s) explicitly flagged as [⚡ MODEL KHUYẾN NGHỊ: SEEDANCE · 10.0s / 15.0s].
